query:
SELECT
                         COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64",
                         COALESCE(SUM(s.user_id = ?2), 0) AS "by_user!: i64"
                       FROM rsvps r
                       JOIN rsvp_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
                       WHERE s.coupon_id = ?1 AND r.discount > 0 AND s.id != ?3
                         AND s.status NOT IN ('refund_pending', 'refund_confirmed')
